quality_interpretation: Internal ordinal hemolysis-risk/plausibility preference; no activity, MIC, HC50, selectivity or official qualification estimate.
comparison_population: All hard-library-eligible exact N-to-C/chemistry identities from all ten complete final libraries; lexical input order.
shortlist_panel_id: common-full-v1 (same values, same full comparison population; no re-ranking on shortlist)

evaluators.endpoint: Published strong-hemolysis label (HC50 <=100 uM), mixed mammalian assay contexts
evaluators.validation: hemolysis_validation; independent homology-filtered n=100; ensemble AUROC 0.748, CI 0.655..0.843; component evidence also retained
evaluators.shared_dependencies: Same HemoPI2 labels and overlapping descriptors as hemo_trees; not independent biological evidence

evaluators.configuration: 300 trees, min_samples_leaf=5, max_features=0.7, random_state=31; prediction n_jobs=1 for reproducible reduction
evaluators.validation: hemolysis_validation; component AUROC 0.7596 in homology-filtered n=100
evaluators.shared_dependencies: Same labels as hemo_logistic and run02 ESM hemolysis; do not count ensemble mean again

evaluators.configuration: Targets hydrophobic fraction .45/scale .14, charge fraction .20/.13, length 21/10, binary 100-degree hydrophobic moment .20/.18; source formula unchanged
evaluators.validation: No established efficacy, toxicity or synthesis validation; historical audit inconclusive
evaluators.shared_dependencies: Length/composition overlaps risk descriptors; family separation is a declared endpoint/preference distinction, not independence

aggregation.ties: average ranks; aggregate ties normalized sequence lexicographic
aggregation.borda: (N-rank)/(N-1); N=1 uses 1 for nonconstant values; constants globally omitted
aggregation.within_family: mean of per-evaluator Borda; identical evaluator copies collapsed globally
aggregation.missingness: error on any nonfinite compared score; retry inference once; persistent failure requires global declared panel revision, never per-candidate omission
aggregation.median_diagnostic: Median of active evaluator ordinal ranks; lexical ties; no default switch

identity.normalization: strip each FASTA line, skip blank lines, join wrapped lines and uppercase ordinary sequence text; explicit chemistry preserved, incompatible or unresolved notation rejected
identity.chemistry: linear canonical L residues, free unmodified termini; based on source disclosure, not measured
